dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Okay, so who are these "scammers" you keep going on about?

dialogues.speaker: Boncza
dialogues.text: Well! I can't just... expose them to outsiders, right? How else am I supposed to make a living...?

dialogues.speaker: Boncza
dialogues.text: I—In any case, if you want to go in and look around, Kruchek from The Flagship, Golitsyna from Mead-Boy, and Cairuo from the market are all good people.

dialogues.speaker: Boncza
dialogues.text: As for other places... You should be careful about spending money there. Don't say I didn't warn you!
